I'm covered under my employer's policy for 10 lakh, that's plenty

Employer cover belongs to the employer's group policy; the regulator's option to move it into your own name applies only when you leave the group, which means you can't simply transfer the coverage while staying with the same employer. Moving from group cover to your own policy may be subject to the insurer's underwriting, which means you could face different terms. Does that change how you view relying solely on your employer's plan?
